_comment: Runtime-bundle manifest. The canopy plugin's Python runtime (the orchestrator package, scripts/, evals/) lives at the REPO root, one level above plugins/canopy/, so a plain plugin install would exclude it. The updaters (skills/update Step 2 and hooks/fleet_session_start_update.py) read this manifest and rsync each listed repo-root path into <plugin-cache>/<dest>/ right after syncing the plugin itself, so every installed plugin version carries the exact matching runtime. Skills resolve it via scripts/canopy-runtime.sh — never via a dev checkout.
